notes: “Make it 4K but faster” keeps the upscale instead of playing your video at double speed, “make it 4K without sound” now does both, and “upscale by 2” upscales 2×. Plain requests like “fix my old tape”, “use the fast model” and “enlarge it” now work. On portrait phone videos, “make it 4K” and “make it 1080p” give the size you asked for, and “this reel is grainy” cleans up your film reel instead of cutting it into highlights. Transparent PNGs keep their transparency when upscaled, looping a tape file makes a video QuickTime opens, a short 4:3 clip no longer letterboxes a widescreen edit, and the Export panel no longer offers AV1 in a MOV file. A license key pasted in lower case or with “License key:” in front now activates, and the price in the app always matches the unlock window.
